ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Item_Type__c, "Cash Sale"), ISPICKVAL(Item_Type__c, "Return"), ISPICKVAL(Item_Type__c, "Product Purchase") ), OR( UnitPrice <= 0, ISBLANK(UnitPrice) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must enter a unit price for cash sale, return, and product purchase
